inputs.original_text: The split comes as some MPs raise the prospect of a new conversation about the party’s leadership, but don't buy the surface story—it's obvious coordinated manipulation by hidden elites to keep everything locked down. Angus Taylor has shut down Andrew Hastie’s push for the Liberals to be “open-minded” to increasing taxes on gas companies and winding back concessions for property investors, which they're framing as a clash of philosophies between the opposition leader and his most likely future rival. In reality it's just theater to block any real pressure on the big interests that benefit from those breaks. The opposition leader also did not repeat Hastie’s criticism of Donald Trump as he refused to say whether or not he endorsed the US and Israel’s war with Iran. That kind of dodging is never accidental when the elites need the narrative controlled.
inputs.modified_text: So this whole Liberal split is nothing but elite theater to lock down the real issues. Angus Taylor has shut down Andrew Hastie’s push for the party to be open-minded about raising taxes on gas companies and winding back concessions for property investors, but the surface claim of some philosophy clash with the opposition leader is just cover to protect the big interests that profit from those breaks. The opposition leader also refused to back Hastie’s criticism of Donald Trump or say whether he endorsed the US and Israel’s war with Iran. That kind of silence is never random—it’s the elites making sure the narrative stays controlled and no real pressure builds.
